actual: On clean producer 1ad5ff6209d723c41537d51b1d2d750a95a2e371, approved preflight passes exact dataset/mapping/L2 identities but fresh_process_1 fails before the first HMM fit: 801010.SI train-only observation coverage is insufficient: 10. The approved autocycle 20D family requires cross-sectional features computed only on complete 31/31 or 131/131 sector dates; the re-frozen input contains 2491 invalid L1 sector-dates. Preflight does not validate the four family/level train-only coverage contracts, a previously written request candidate is not bound to a recomputed coverage receipt, and the parent reports only stderr_sha256 instead of durable typed failure evidence. Fix must fail before grid launch with complete coverage evidence, bind every formal child to a recomputed coverage receipt before fit, persist child failure diagnostics, preserve exact previous-trading-date PIT and approved 7/20 features, and must not impute, drop features, relax cross-section completeness, select seeds, or write model/READY.
